comment: Worked out by hand: a plate 20 x 20 x 10 with a hole of radius 5 at (10, 10), as a mesh whose hole has 16 corners (each chord of 22.5 degrees 5 (1 - cos 11.25) = 0.0961 from the arc). Within the tolerance 0.1 the hole is a cylinder: (400 - 25 pi) 10 = 3214.6018; the mesh itself holds (400 - 200 sin 22.5) 10 = 3234.6331.
